title: HELIX Terminology: Ethnicity/Race
description: Self-reported race and ethnicity categories. Multi-select (a person may identify with multiple categories). Based on US IPEDS categories with international extensions.

codes.definition: A person of Cuban, Mexican, Puerto Rican, South or Central American, or other Spanish culture or origin, regardless of race

codes.display: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

codes.definition: Derived category for IPEDS reporting. Calculated when multiple race codes are selected.
IPEDS category for international students on non-immigrant visas. NOT a race/ethnicity; used as an IPEDS reporting overlay.
Person declined to report or data is not available
A category not captured above. Document in institution or country-specific profile.

notes: IPEDS requires institutions to first ask about Hispanic/Latino ethnicity, then ask about race (multi-select). For IPEDS reporting, 'two_or_more' is derived from the selections. Non-US institutions should define country-specific ethnicity/race profiles as HELIX Implementation Profiles (e.g., UK uses different categories for HESA).
